# Assignments

There are six online assignments delivered through childsmath. Assignment
credit is strictly for participation: whether your answers are correct or
incorrect does not affect your assignment mark.

Each completed assignment is worth one percentage point, up to a maximum of
5%. Thus, your best five of the six assignments count. If you complete all six,
your assignment mark is still 5%; if you miss one, you can still earn the full
5% by completing the other five.

The due dates below are tentative. They may be adjusted if the pace of the
course changes. The precise opening and closing times shown in childsmath take
precedence if there is any discrepancy.

The HTML and PDF links give one generated instance of each assignment;
numerical values and choice orders may differ from yours on Childsmath.
PDFs contain questions only. The HTML versions of Assignments 1–3 have
clickable answers. Assignment 4 currently contains questions only.
